claimText: A separation minimum of 2 minutes shall be applied between a LIGHT or MEDIUM aircraft and a HEAVY aircraft, and between a LIGHT aircraft and a MEDIUM aircraft, when the heavier aircraft is making a low or missed approach and the lighter aircraft is landing on the same runway in the opposite direction, or on a parallel opposite-direction runway separated by less than 760 m (2 500 ft).
